caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden mantel clock with a peaked roof and two decorative finials at the top corners. The clock is primarily brown, with visible wood grain texture, and has a rectangular base that widens slightly at the bottom. The upper half of the clock features a large circular clock face with black Roman numerals and two hands; the background of the clock face is a pale, off-white color. Below the clock face, there is a rectangular glass panel that shows a monochromatic blue and white image of a house with columns, surrounded by trees and a fence, resembling a pastoral scene. The door on the front of the clock has a round knob on the left side. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects present. In the lower right corner of the image, there is printed text that reads "FRANCIS LAW DURAND."
title: Steeple Clock
